name: iRhythm Holdings, Inc.
summary: iRhythm Holdings, Inc., a digital healthcare company, engages in the design, development, and commercialization of device-based technology that provides ambulatory cardiac monitoring services to diagnose arrhythmias in the United States. The company offers Zio ambulatory cardiac monitoring services, including long-term and short-term continuous monitoring and mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring services.
